limitations: G1 is a finite numerical sufficient-condition proxy, not an exact ambient-isotopy proof.
The exact Liu et al. branch invariant c(tau) depends on infinite-order torsion zeros and is not certifiable from finite samples.
B1 is soft by default until PKLSA reach/dcsd is independently certified against ideal-knot contact geometry.
D1/D2 are handoff diagnostics and do not claim NLSE, Biot-Savart, finite-core, reconnection, or dynamical stability.
